{"reply": "Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the worry this has caused. The good news is that your data is very likely not lost — this is almost always a display/mapping issue rather than actual data loss.

Here's what's probably happening: when tasks are bulk-moved to a new board, custom fields only carry over automatically if the destination board has a field with the exact same name, type, and configuration as the source (in this case, 'Priority Score'). If the new board doesn't have a matching field, the underlying value is typically preserved in our database but is no longer displayed or linked to the task, since there's no corresponding field to show it in.

To confirm and recover the data, could you let me know:
1. Does the new board have a 'Priority Score' custom field set up at all? If not, that's almost certainly the cause.
2. If it does exist on the new board, does the field type match (e.g., number vs. dropdown) what was on the original board?

In the meantime, our support team can check the task history/audit log on our end to verify the original values are still intact, so please don't manually re-enter the data yet. Could you share the board name (or task IDs) for a couple of the affected tasks so we can pull that up and confirm?

Once we verify, we can either help you set up the matching field on the new board and restore the values, or walk you through it if it needs to be done manually.

Thanks for your patience — we'll get this sorted out.

Best,
Loopwise Support"}
